spokenLines.text: Did you know that How black holes destroy stars might be one of the most violent spectacles in the entire universe?
spokenLines.visualBeat: Vast cosmic void and gathering gravitational forces

spokenLines.text: As matter is drawn past the point of no return, gravitational friction heats surrounding gas to millions of degrees.
spokenLines.visualBeat: Swirling accretion vortex of blinding plasma

spokenLines.text: Tidal forces stretch entire stars into incandescent ribbons of plasma, before consuming them entirely.
spokenLines.visualBeat: Cataclysmic stellar destruction and energy jet

spokenLines.text: What remains are radiant shockwaves that illuminate the dark cosmos for billions of light years.
spokenLines.visualBeat: Expanding shockwaves glowing across distant galaxies

fullText: Did you know that How black holes destroy stars might be one of the most violent spectacles in the entire universe? As matter is drawn past the point of no return, gravitational friction heats surrounding gas to millions of degrees. Tidal forces stretch entire stars into incandescent ribbons of plasma, before consuming them entirely. What remains are radiant shockwaves that illuminate the dark cosmos for billions of light years.
